title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: source context based file protection
summary: The briefing incorrectly says who can author the new DLP rules is undocumented: Microsoft publishes permissions for creating and deploying DLP policies. The roadmap facts and the narrowly stated gaps in source-context documentation are supported, but the policy-scoping UI path also stops before the scope control.

claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe this source-context capability beyond the roadmap description.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Purview source context'; 'Endpoint DLP source downloaded protection condition'. Opened Endpoint DLP overview, getting-started, policy reference and Purview what's new; no description of protecting files by download website or creating app was found.

claims.claim: Endpoint DLP extends monitoring and protection to onboarded Windows 10/11, macOS and certain Windows Server devices.
claims.quote: (Endpoint DLP) extends the activity monitoring and protection capabilities of DLP to Windows 10/11, macOS (the three latest released major versions) devices, and Windows certain server versions.

claims.claim: Devices must be onboarded to Microsoft Purview to be used as locations in DLP policies.
claims.quote: You need to onboard all the devices you want to use as locations in your DLP policies.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published which operating systems, browsers or apps the new source-context protection covers.
claims.quote: Searched: 'source context DLP default Windows macOS rollout audit'; 'Endpoint DLP source context licence meter default platforms roles'. Opened Endpoint DLP overview, getting-started, policy reference and what's new; results describe other Endpoint DLP capabilities, not this feature's coverage.

claims.claim: Existing Endpoint DLP conditions include file-content conditions and a website-access condition.
claims.quote: Content contains: Specifies content to be detected. ... The user accessed a sensitive website from Microsoft Edge:

claims.claim: The existing sensitive-website condition concerns a website the user accesses, not the originating website of a downloaded file.
claims.quote: Specifically, we want to audit or restrict actions such as copying data, printing content, or saving web pages locally when users access designated sensitive service domains.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/endpoint-dlp-create-policy-restrict-access-to-domains to sources; it explains the access-based meaning of the condition already named by the cited policy reference.

claims.where: controls[0]; summary; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: No UI setting or automation for protecting files by source website or creating app is documented, and the Endpoint conditions list has no such condition.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Endpoint DLP source website creating app condition Set-DlpComplianceRule PowerShell'. Read Endpoint conditions and searched Set-DlpComplianceRule for source, origin, download, website, domain, URL and app parameters; no source-website or creating-app control was found.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Autonomy & actions; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether a source match audits, restricts, labels or encrypts the file.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Endpoint DLP source downloaded protection condition'; 'source context DLP default Windows macOS rollout audit'. Opened Endpoint DLP overview, policy reference and what's new; no source-match action semantics were found. The roadmap only says 'Protect file'.

claims.claim: No identity or permission change specific to this capability is described.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Endpoint DLP source author permissions'; 'Endpoint DLP source context licence meter default platforms roles'. Read the roadmap, policy reference, what's new and DLP creation permissions; general DLP permissions are published, but no feature-specific permission change was found.

claims.claim: Who can author the new DLP rules is not documented.
claims.quote: The account you use to create and deploy policies must be a member of one of these role groups: Compliance administrator; Compliance data administrator; Information Protection; Information Protection Admin; Security administrator
claims.fix: Replace 'Who can author the new rules is not documented.' with 'Microsoft documents DLP policy creation and deployment for the Compliance administrator, Compliance data administrator, Information Protection, Information Protection Admin, and Security administrator role groups; no additional permission specific to source-context protection is published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-create-deploy-policy#permissions and add that page to sources.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Policies is the UI route given for configuring which users an Endpoint DLP policy covers.
claims.quote: In the left navigation pane, select Data loss prevention > Policies. ... Create and scope a policy that is applied only to the Devices location.
claims.fix: The printed steps reach the correct policy list but stop before scope selection. Set controls[1].ui.path to 'Data loss prevention > Policies > Create policy > Enterprise applications & devices > Categories > Custom > Regulations > Custom policy > Admin units > Full directory > Devices > Edit > All users, groups, and adaptive scopes'. Use https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/endpoint-dlp-create-policy-device-scoping for docs and add it to sources. This documented route selects the all-users scope.

claims.claim: Set-DlpCompliancePolicy -Identity <policy> -AddEndpointDlpLocation <users> modifies the included accounts for an Endpoint DLP policy.
claims.quote: The AddEndpointDLPLocation parameter specifies the user accounts to add to the list of included accounts for Endpoint DLP if you used the value All for the EndpointDLPLocation parameter. You identify the account by name or email address.

claims.claim: AddEndpointDlpLocation adds included user accounts where EndpointDLPLocation was set to All.
claims.quote: The AddEndpointDLPLocation parameter specifies the user accounts to add to the list of included accounts for Endpoint DLP if you used the value All for the EndpointDLPLocation parameter.

claims.claim: AddEndpointDlpLocation requires membership in the Compliance Administrator or Compliance Data Administrator role in Microsoft Entra ID.
claims.quote: This parameter requires membership in the Compliance Administrator or Compliance Data Administrator roles in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.claim: The documented alternative scopes users in the Devices location rather than setting a source-based file condition.
claims.quote: The AddEndpointDLPLocation parameter specifies the user accounts to add to the list of included accounts for Endpoint DLP
